entries.proposition: Design: retrospective single-unit cohort of all neonates born at 24+0 to 31+6 weeks, 2004-2019, split by birth date into three epochs.
entries.snippet: We conducted a retrospective cohort analysis in the NICU of the Leiden University Medical Center

experimental_context.system: 2577 preterm neonates (24+0 to 31+6 weeks) admitted to one Dutch tertiary neonatal intensive care unit, 2004-2019, in three consecutive epochs
experimental_context.comparator: epoch I (2004-2009) versus II (2009-2014) versus III (2014-2019); no concurrent comparison
experimental_context.endpoint: percentage of neonates given fresh-frozen plasma, percentage tested for coagulation, indications, major haemorrhage

entries.proposition: The unit's guideline for plasma was unchanged throughout: treat non-bleeding neonates whose aPTT or PT exceeds twice the mid-point of the reference value with 10 mL/kg; reference ranges come from a 30-36-week cohort and were applied to infants below 30 weeks.
